tasks.label: cleanup
tasks.command: rm main.pdf 2>/dev/null; find przyklady -maxdepth 1 -name '*.pdf' -type f -print -exec rm {} + 2>/dev/null; find szablon -maxdepth 2 -name '*.pdf' -type f -print -exec rm {} + 2>/dev/null;

tasks.label: compile PDF with typst - docker
tasks.command: docker run --rm --name typst-compile-inzynierka -v $(pwd):/data -w /data ghcr.io/typst/typst compile main.typ
